ios.desc:
A 2-hour lecture, a 60-page PDF or a long YouTube video: SumApp turns it into clear notes in seconds, then quizzes you on it.

SUMMARIZE YOUTUBE VIDEOS
Paste a link and get the key ideas and takeaways as bullet points. Learn in minutes instead of watching for hours.

SUMMARIZE PDFS AND DOCUMENTS
Upload textbooks, articles, slides or reports. SumApp pulls out the main points and key terms. Snap a photo of a page and it reads the text for you (OCR).

RECORD AND TRANSCRIBE LECTURES
Record a class or meeting. SumApp transcribes it, summarizes it and lists the action items.

AI QUIZ FROM YOUR NOTES
Generate practice questions from any summary. Test yourself before the exam and see what you missed.

CHAT WITH YOUR DOCUMENT
Ask "What is the main argument?" or "Explain chapter 3 simply." Answers come from your own source.

BUILT FOR
• Students: lecture notes, exam prep, book summaries
• Professionals: meeting notes, report summaries
• Creators: video and podcast summaries

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your data is encrypted, never shared with third parties, and you can delete it any time.

SumApp Premium unlocks unlimited summaries, quizzes and recording time. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled; manage them in your App Store account settings.

PRIVACY & SECURITY FIRST
Your trust is our priority. SumApp ensures military-grade encryption for all processed data. We never share your audio files or summaries with third parties. You maintain 100% control over your data—delete anytime.

Download SumApp AI now and turn hours of content into minutes of insight. Faster, smarter, easier.
